thread_text:
kevin: Quick check — can we lock a 45m slot next week for a sprint-review that doubles as a light post-incident review? Need folks who touched infra, product, and the oncall timeline.

tara: +1. Prefer AM slots for me. Agenda idea: 1) timeline 2) impact 3) action owners 4) triage notes.

maria: I can do Tue/Wed morning. Will prep a short timeline doc and flag any open PRs.

oliver: Wed 10-11am PT works for me. Also suggest a 10min diagnosis quick-hit section for engineers to call out root-cause candidates.

kevin: Cool. @ian are you ok to coordinate with product and confirm stakeholders? Also who should facilitate -- rotate or nominate?

ian: I can confirm product. I don't mind facilitating this one if Tara wants to be in the notes owner role.

oncall-bot: Incident runbook export: https://internal.runbooks/incidents/INC-2026-0421 (automated)

sam: Wed 10am PT is fine. For prework: can we ask participants to paste 1-2 bulletestimates of user impact + any PRs that reverted or rolled back? Keeps the meeting tight.

kevin: Yep — ask sent to the attendees list. Prework checklist: - timeline (5 bullets) - top 2 hypotheses - any deploy/rollbacks - follow-up owners. I'll put a calendar poll.

maria: For follow-ups, can we track owners in the ticket, not in the meeting notes? Easier for tracking.

tara: Agreed. I can create a short ticket template and assign initial owners during the call.

oliver: Also: quick decision rule for production rollbacks / upgrades — propose to include a 5-step decision checklist in the agenda so we can resolve in-meeting.

kevin: Nice. Draft agenda (45m):
```
- 5m: goals + scope (facilitator)
- 10m: timeline & data (maria)
- 10m: engineering signal & quick diag (oliver/sam)
- 10m: action triage & owners (group)
- 5m: next steps, tickets, and checks (tara)
```

ian: If nobody objects I'll send calendar invite for Wed 10–10:45 PT and add the ticket + agenda link.

maria: No objections here. I'll upload a short timeline doc to the agenda before EOD Tue.

sam: Adding: please paste any relevant logs or errors inline if you can't attend live. We can triage async and record owners.

kevin: Thanks all — tagging the set: @maria @oliver @tara @ian @sam. If anything major comes up before the invite, reply here. :thumbsup:
